summary: fix(settings): remove backdrop blur over iOS pair menu toolbar
description:
Because:

* On iOS, a blur covered the toolbar in the menu image on the
  "Finish pairing in the app" screen.
* WebKit paints the Figma backdrop-filter foreignObject above the SVG.

This commit:

* Removes the foreignObject blur layer and its unused clipPath from
  graphic_pair_menu_ios.min.svg.

Closes FXA-14953
